inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Inspect condition-to-mesh boundary transfer for a successful, settled mesh-only job tied to this exact live input revision. This never reruns the mesher or solver.
limitations: Static linear structural inputs only. Requires a retained successful mesh-only job whose frozen and output input revisions both match.

Reports boundary transfer plus an additive rigidBody result (per-mode eliminated/free for the six rigid-body motions of nodal fixed/displacement supports; free modes add error ANALYSIS_RIGID_BODY_MODE_FREE without refusing the inspection; springs are not modelled). completePreflight is always false; convergence and physical accuracy remain unchecked.
